narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic true-mystery storyteller. Urgent and excited, punchy rhythm, rising curiosity, vivid emphasis on the strange details. No long pauses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kentucky, eighteen seventy-six. Meat fell from the sky.

voice.instruct: Dramatic, excited opening hook, punchy and fast, hitting 'Meat fell from the sky' hard, no pause between phrases.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mrs. Crouch was making soap outside when pieces started landing around her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two men later tasted some and said it was meat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: How did it get up there?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One theory says vultures threw up food while flying overhead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the eighteen seventy-six reports never mention any birds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: To this day, nobody can prove exactly what happened on that Kentucky farm.
